traits.name: Deflector
traits.trigger: Reachable on-target shot where a parry is safer or more feasible than a catch.
traits.effect: After a successful base save, prefer a reachable safe deflection sector and add at most 15% rebound speed; does not raise save probability by itself.
traits.visual: Cyan label and keeper ring; short cyan trail only after real ball contact.
traits.success: A legal save followed by the ball clearing the immediate central danger area; a rebound to an attacker is not celebrated as success.
traits.counterplay: Unreachable shots still score; covering attackers can collect rebounds; corners remain possible.

traits.name: Safe Hands
traits.trigger: Reachable catchable shot/cross with low crowd/contact risk.
traits.effect: Add +4 HAN to this holding-versus-parry/control decision; never turn an unreachable ball into a catch.
traits.visual: Closed-hand icon over keeper; small contracting ring on an actual hold.
traits.success: Keeper establishes legal hand control.
traits.counterplay: High ball speed, pressure and contested crosses still cause spills.

traits.name: Cat Reflexes
traits.trigger: Keeper detects a reachable close-range shot.
traits.effect: Reduce this keeper's reaction delay by 15%, within the common reaction floor.
traits.visual: Small cyan double pulse and REFLEX label; flash at actual contact.
traits.success: Shot is saved; a mere dive is not a success.
traits.counterplay: Placement, screens, finite dive range and late visibility remain relevant.

traits.name: Sweeper Keeper
traits.trigger: A reachable through ball outside the goal area creates a feasible interception.
traits.effect: Improve this rush's acceleration by 20%, bounded by legal movement and keeping/handling zones.
traits.visual: Dotted forward ring and SWEEPER label; success ring on claim/clearance.
traits.success: A legal claim or clearance before the attacker.
traits.counterplay: Can be chipped or beaten; no handling outside the penalty area.

traits.name: Launch Keeper
traits.trigger: Keeper has legal hand control and an onside receiver in an open counter lane.
traits.effect: Increase feasible throw range by 12%; placement and receiver control still use base execution.
traits.visual: Cyan release arc, LAUNCH label and fading ball streak.
traits.success: Intended teammate controls the distribution.
traits.counterplay: No target or occupied lane cancels selection; no direct thrown goal.

traits.name: Hard Tackle
traits.trigger: A reachable, committed standing/body challenge has a legal angle.
traits.effect: Add +4 DEF to this contest; do not extend collision reach, erase fouls, or guarantee retention.
traits.visual: Amber/teal aura and HARD TACKLE label; small impact ring only on contact.
traits.success: Clean possession win, not a foul or merely touching the ball.
traits.counterplay: Shielding, a one-two, mistimed contact and cover can beat it.

traits.name: Anticipator
traits.trigger: A predicted pass crosses a reachable lane the defender is covering.
traits.effect: Reduce the own response delay to that pass by 15%; pursue its actual path.
traits.visual: Teal eye/chevron cue and ANTICIPATE label.
traits.success: Legal interception/control or meaningful deflection.
traits.counterplay: A disguised/fast pass, third runner or unreachable lane remains effective.

traits.name: Aerial Fortress
traits.trigger: Defender reaches a descending contestable high ball.
traits.effect: Add +4 PHY for the one aerial contest.
traits.visual: Brief upright teal ring and AERIAL label; contact burst on a clearance.
traits.success: Wins the contest and clears/controls away from immediate danger.
traits.counterplay: Timing and opposing position matter; ground cutbacks bypass aerial strength.

traits.name: Body Block
traits.trigger: Defender is planted near a physically reachable shot path.
traits.effect: Extend the committed block envelope by at most 0.15 field units; no distant ball attraction.
traits.visual: Short shield/semicircle facing the shot; BLOCK label.
traits.success: A real physical block prevents the original shot reaching the goal.
traits.counterplay: Feints, passes and shots outside the small envelope beat it.

traits.name: Accelerator
traits.trigger: A chosen overlap, support or carry run has open space.
traits.effect: For 1.2 active seconds, increase acceleration 30% and top speed at most 6%, under the global movement cap.
traits.visual: Pale-blue aura, ACCELERATOR label and short behind-token streaks.
traits.success: Neutral completion at expiry; a success pip only when the committed run objective is reached.
traits.counterplay: Cover, body position, stamina and offside still apply.

traits.name: Whipped Cross
traits.trigger: Wide player has a viable moving aerial target or space target.
traits.effect: Increase allowed cross curvature by 15%; ordinary aim error, height and flight contact remain.
traits.visual: Amber curved flight streak and CROSS label.
traits.success: Target-side teammate legally controls or shoots from the delivery.
traits.counterplay: Cross may miss, be claimed or cleared; no target lock.

traits.name: Recovery Sprint
traits.trigger: Team loses controlled possession with an exposed corridor behind this player.
traits.effect: Increase top speed by at most 6% for 2 active seconds during the chosen recovery run.
traits.visual: Blue backward chevrons, RECOVER label and short movement streak.
traits.success: Reaches assigned cover space or makes a legal recovery intervention.
traits.counterplay: Fatigue, an earlier run and a one-two can still bypass the player.

traits.name: Overlap Engine
traits.trigger: A coordinated overlap has assigned defensive cover.
traits.effect: Reduce own movement stamina drain by 15% for this run, capped at 3 active seconds.
traits.visual: Quiet blue/green lane pulse and OVERLAP label.
traits.success: Run reaches a useful support point; no automatic pass required.
traits.counterplay: Exposed defence lowers run utility; possession loss cancels the attacking intention.

traits.name: Screen
traits.trigger: A covering midfielder can physically intercept a ball through the protected central lane.
traits.effect: Add +3 DEF to this reached interception/control contest.
traits.visual: Teal bar/eye icon, SCREEN label and a contact tick.
traits.success: Legal interception or useful central deflection.
traits.counterplay: Wide switches and third-player runs create alternative paths.

traits.name: Anchor
traits.trigger: Holder receives under immediate grounded pressure with a shielding angle.
traits.effect: Add +4 PHY for a single shielding/strength contest.
traits.visual: Low stable green ring and ANCHOR label.
traits.success: Retains control through the contest or releases a legal outlet.
traits.counterplay: A second presser or blocked outlet remains dangerous.

traits.name: Switch Play
traits.trigger: Opposite wing has useful space and a feasible diagonal pass.
traits.effect: Reduce angular aim dispersion by 10% for this pass; do not improve the receiver's first touch.
traits.visual: Wide amber arc and SWITCH label.
traits.success: Intended receiver controls on the opposite side.
traits.counterplay: Closing the far side or pressuring the passer can defeat it.

traits.name: Bullet Pass
traits.trigger: A grounded medium-range pass into a reachable lane is selected.
traits.effect: Increase actual ball speed by 15%, capped by pass-speed tuning; ordinary placement error and receiving difficulty remain.
traits.visual: Golden ball with white core, short gold trail and BULLET PASS label.
traits.success: Intended receiver controls; launch alone is not success.
traits.counterplay: A blocked lane still intercepts; fast arrival can cause a poor first touch.

traits.name: Wall Pass
traits.trigger: Cardholder is the bounce receiver in a valid one-two intention.
traits.effect: Reduce own return-pass preparation by 20%; the return is still chosen only if useful.
traits.visual: Two linked small pips and ONE-TWO label; normal real ball path.
traits.success: Original runner controls the return pass.
traits.counterplay: Tracking the runner or blocking either leg breaks the pattern.

traits.name: Tempo Setter
traits.trigger: Holder identifies a safe useful recycle/switch while the team is building.
traits.effect: Reduce own preparation delay by 15% for this selected release.
traits.visual: Single amber pulse and TEMPO label.
traits.success: Selected teammate legally controls; no bonus to that teammate's attributes.
traits.counterplay: Pressure or a newly closed lane can force a different action before commitment.

traits.name: Press Resistant
traits.trigger: Two opponents are close enough to make real pressure credible.
traits.effect: Add +4 DRI to one receive/turn/retention contest.
traits.visual: Tight teal/ivory ring and PRESS RESIST label.
traits.success: Controls/retains or exits the pressure with a legal release.
traits.counterplay: Space, first-touch speed and covering defenders still matter.

traits.name: Threader
traits.trigger: A viable grounded line-breaking/through pass is selected.
traits.effect: Add +3 PAS to placement of that one pass; ordinary defenders and offside still apply.
traits.visual: Narrow amber tracer and THREADER label.
traits.success: Intended runner controls the legal ball beyond the intended line.
traits.counterplay: Cover and pass-time offside can defeat it; no steering to receiver.

traits.name: Third Man
traits.trigger: Two teammates begin a valid combination and this cardholder has a useful third-player lane.
traits.effect: Reduce own reaction/start delay for that run by 15%; no teammate is forced to pass.
traits.visual: Three small connected pips and THIRD MAN label.
traits.success: Runner reaches a viable onside receiving window; reception may earn a separate pass event.
traits.counterplay: Tracking, early interception or loss cancels the intention.

traits.name: Turn and Go
traits.trigger: Holder receives with a viable turn into space.
traits.effect: Increase own turning rate by 15% for up to 1.2 active seconds.
traits.visual: Short crescent aura and TURN label.
traits.success: Completes the turn while retaining control.
traits.counterplay: A close defender, bad touch or closed space can stop it.

traits.name: Touchline Burst
traits.trigger: Wide carrier chooses to beat a reachable marker along available outside space.
traits.effect: Increase own acceleration by 30% for 1.2 active seconds; normal top-speed limit remains.
traits.visual: Pale-blue outside-lane streak and BURST label.
traits.success: Passes the immediate marker with controlled possession.
traits.counterplay: Touchline, cover and ball control can defeat the run.

traits.name: Cutback
traits.trigger: A byline carrier identifies a genuinely open delayed receiver.
traits.effect: Add +3 PAS to the grounded backward/diagonal delivery.
traits.visual: Short backwards amber streak and CUTBACK label.
traits.success: Intended late runner legally controls or shoots.
traits.counterplay: A tracking midfielder or actual lane block can intercept.

traits.name: Cut Inside
traits.trigger: Wide holder has a useful inside lane and suitable body/foot orientation.
traits.effect: Increase own turning rate by 15% for 1.2 active seconds.
traits.visual: Crescent movement cue and CUT INSIDE label.
traits.success: Completes the inside turn with control.
traits.counterplay: A compact block can close the route; a shot is not forced.

traits.name: Close Control
traits.trigger: A difficult but reachable pass arrives and requires a controlled first touch.
traits.effect: Reduce own first-touch displacement error by 15%.
traits.visual: Small contracting ivory ring and CONTROL label.
traits.success: Ball enters legal close control.
traits.counterplay: Excessive arrival speed or defender contact can still win the ball.

traits.name: Finesse Shot
traits.trigger: A reachable curved-shot lane with useful shooting angle is chosen.
traits.effect: Increase allowed planar curve capacity by 25% within the trajectory limit; base aim error and actual keeper defence remain.
traits.visual: FINESSE label and a short warm-white curved trail following actual ball positions.
traits.success: A goal is full success; saved/on-target is partial, not a goal celebration.
traits.counterplay: Shot may be blocked, saved or miss; curve cannot bend through a defender.

traits.name: First-time Finish
traits.trigger: A contestable incoming ball can be struck without a settling touch.
traits.effect: Add +4 SHO to that first-time strike.
traits.visual: Brief ivory strike spark and FIRST TIME label.
traits.success: A legal goal; on-target saved is only partial.
traits.counterplay: Poor arrival, defenders and limited body orientation remain relevant.

traits.name: Power Strike
traits.trigger: A useful direct shot with enough preparation space is selected.
traits.effect: Increase actual shot speed by 12%, under the shot cap, with 0.15 active seconds extra windup.
traits.visual: Short warm-white heavy streak, small release ring and POWER label.
traits.success: A legal goal; a save/block is not success.
traits.counterplay: Longer windup allows a challenge; aim does not improve automatically.

traits.name: Poacher
traits.trigger: A loose ball/rebound or close pass offers a useful box finish.
traits.effect: Reduce own settle/shot preparation by 15% for this one action.
traits.visual: Small amber near-ball pulse and POACHER label.
traits.success: A legal goal before the chance closes.
traits.counterplay: Defender cover, reach and offside still matter.

traits.name: Aerial Finisher
traits.trigger: Player legally reaches and contests a descending attacking ball.
traits.effect: Add +4 SHO to the header after winning/qualifying for the actual aerial contact.
traits.visual: Upright ivory pulse, header contact spark and HEADER label.
traits.success: A legal headed goal; a won duel alone is partial.
traits.counterplay: PHY/timing/marking can prevent contact; goalkeeper may save.

traits.name: Dead-ball Artist
traits.trigger: Assigned available taker has a selected legal free-kick delivery or direct attempt.
traits.effect: Reduce own aim dispersion by 10% for the committed kick.
traits.visual: Amber stationary-ball ring and DEAD BALL label; trail after actual release.
traits.success: Delivery controlled or direct goal as appropriate; indirect rules still apply.
traits.counterplay: Wall, range, defender and keeper can defeat it.

traits.name: Penalty Composure
traits.trigger: Cardholder is the eligible committed penalty taker.
traits.effect: Reduce placement dispersion by 10%; no auto-goal, keeper freeze or perfect corner lock.
traits.visual: Small steady ivory ring and COMPOSED label before the kick.
traits.success: A legal scored penalty.
traits.counterplay: The keeper, posts and own execution can still stop it.

traits.name: Long Throw
traits.trigger: An assigned throw-in taker has a legal useful distant target.
traits.effect: Increase available throw range by 12%, within a declared cap.
traits.visual: Short dotted amber arc and LONG THROW label.
traits.success: A teammate legally controls the delivery.
traits.counterplay: Interceptions and direct-goal throw rules remain.

traits.name: Super Substitute
traits.trigger: Player enters as a legal substitute in this fixture for the first time.
traits.effect: Add +4 PAC for five displayed match minutes; no duplicate entry refresh.
traits.visual: Small blue entry pulse and SUPER SUB label; subdued icon during the window.
traits.success: Neutral expiry; actual successful actions get their own event feedback.
traits.counterplay: Finite window, fatigue, ordinary defences and substitution limits remain.
